Reality Fracture Secret Lair Bundle Delayed

Updated information and global availability for the Reality Fracture Secret Lair Bundle.

Due to production and shipping issues, the Reality Fracture Secret Lair Bundle is delayed globally and may arrive shortly after the October 23 release date. Exact delay timing will vary locally.

Your distributor will have the latest information on availability as product reaches them. We'll update if there are additional changes to Secret Lair Bundle availability.
